---
name: Checklist suggestion
about: Suggest a new check, a stack-specific verification, or a fix for a false positive
title: "[check] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What does the check catch?**
Describe the real failure (what went wrong, what the impact was).

**Which tier?**
Tier 1 (breach or real cost), Tier 2 (before real users), or Tier 3 (scale later). Explain why.

**How can it be verified?**
A command, a file to read, or a test to run. Include the stack if it is stack-specific.

**False positives?**
When would this check flag something that is actually fine?
